The answer comes from Pree's own post in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. In it, they said the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it with the store login.

If "site" means a site ID or address, I couldn't find one for Pine Crossing in anything Pree can see. There are no Marrow Agrisupply account files on the share, and neither of the two Central team digests mentions it. I told Pree that part would have to come from the account records.
